scope: Source sampler is based on the published code with queued UV scratch reuse; cached native sites independently verify the complete output. Replay ten native oak/birch/orchard near templates used by falling leaves; compare every site to the actual cached release points. Counts attribute lookups and alpha reader callback evaluations, not measured heap/GC or hardware frame timing. Warm CPU samples use uninstrumented modules over the same corpus. The unchanged release coordinates are the visual-output contract; no shader, geometry, draw or particle behaviour changes.
siteHashEncoding: SHA-256 of JSON xyz objects in source iteration order
